Definition: from G2596 and G5143; to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower:--run down.
BiblicalUsage: The chief captain ran down to them with soldiers and centurions, and when they saw him they left beating Paul.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the running down of the soldiers was God's rescue arriving on time.
